heat_flux_mapping: one toroidal q-map period mapped linearly onto the 0.4 m streamwise heated base and area-normalized

property_model.mu: 1.16e-4 exp(3755/T) Pa s; Sohal/INL (Williams), source range 873-1073 K; explicitly extrapolated over 732-1703 K and held flat outside
property_model.kappa: least-squares k=1.212+9e-5*T W/m/K through Attarian Appendix A.10 800-1200 K values; extrapolated to 1703 K and held flat outside
property_model.table_interpolation: OpenFOAM tabulatedTransport linear interpolation; flat first/last table segments prevent unbounded extrapolation
